target_text: The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to its directors, officers, employees, and professional advisers (together, "Representatives") who have a genuine need to know it for the Purpose, provided that the Receiving Party procures that each such Representative is bound by obligations of confidentiality no less onerous than those set out in this Agreement. The Receiving Party shall be liable for any breach of this Agreement by its Representatives.
new_text: The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to its directors, officers, employees, and professional advisers (together, "Representatives") who have a genuine need to know it for the Purpose, and to the directors, officers, employees, and professional advisers of its group companies (meaning any parent company, subsidiary, or affiliate of the Receiving Party) who have a genuine need to know it for the Purpose, provided that the Receiving Party procures that each such Representative is bound by obligations of confidentiality no less onerous than those set out in this Agreement. The Receiving Party shall be liable for any breach of this Agreement by its Representatives.
comment: Per planner instruction p1 — expands permitted recipients in Clause 3 to include group companies' representatives while keeping them within the existing 'Representatives' defined concept and subject to the same need-to-know, confidentiality undertaking, and liability provisions. No unrestricted group-wide disclosure right created.

new_text: ; (d) is independently developed by or on behalf of the Receiving Party without use of or reference to the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information; or (e) is required to be disclosed by law, regulation, or order of a court of competent jurisdiction, provided that the Receiving Party gives the Disclosing Party prompt written notice where lawful to do so.
comment: Per planner instruction p2 — inserts new independent development exclusion as clause 4(d) and renumbers existing compelled disclosure limb to 4(e).

target_text: Save for liability which cannot be limited or excluded by applicable law, the total aggregate liability of each Party to the other under or in connection with this Agreement, whether in contract, tort (including negligence), breach of statutory duty, or otherwise, shall not exceed one hundred thousand pounds sterling (GBP 100,000).
new_text: Save for liability which cannot be limited or excluded by applicable law, the total aggregate liability of each Party to the other under or in connection with this Agreement, whether in contract, tort (including negligence), breach of statutory duty, or otherwise, shall not exceed one hundred thousand pounds sterling (GBP 100,000), save that this cap shall not apply to liability for fraud, wilful misconduct, or breach of the confidentiality obligations under this Agreement.
comment: Per planner instruction p3 — adds fraud/wilful misconduct/confidentiality breach carve-out to the liability cap while preserving the mandatory-law exclusion and GBP 100,000 threshold for all other claims.

target_text: The parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales for the resolution of all disputes arising out of or in connection with this Agreement.
new_text: Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, including any question regarding its existence, validity, or termination, shall be finally resolved by arbitration under the LCIA Rules, which Rules are deemed incorporated herein by reference. The seat of arbitration shall be London, England, there shall be a sole arbitrator appointed in accordance with the LCIA Rules, the language of the arbitration shall be English, and the award shall be final and binding on the parties.
comment: Per planner instruction p4 — replaces the court litigation jurisdiction clause in Clause 9 with an LCIA arbitration clause specifying sole arbitrator, London seat, English language, and final binding award while preserving the governing law sentence unchanged.
